profile.legal_name: Edge Homes Utah, LLC (held through Edge Utah HoldCo, LLC)
profile.parent: Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. (Tokyo, TSE 1911), through Sumitomo Forestry America, Inc.; bought 70% of Edge Utah HoldCo, LLC in February 2017. Current percentage not confirmed.
markets: Salt Lake County (Herriman, Riverton, Taylorsville, West Jordan, West Valley)
Utah County (Eagle Mountain, Lehi, Saratoga Springs, Mapleton, Spanish Fork)
profile.org_note: One office in Draper, UT and no divisions: a CEO (Steve Maddox, with business partner Gordy Jones) over a CFO, COO, General Counsel and functional VPs. Land is split between a VP of Land Acquisition (Jed Stewart, the published contact for land sellers) and a VP of Land Entitlement (Brandon Watson); the General Counsel also fronts rezones and development agreements. The company is a consolidated subsidiary of Sumitomo Forestry, reached through Sumitomo Forestry America, Inc. (Addison, TX), so group funding decisions sit with the parent.
profile.email_pattern: first@edgehomes.com for most executives (jed@, jared@, brandon@, kyle@); some use first initial + last name (bcovington@, pguymon@, jbryce@, bparr@)
profile.summary: Not an independent private builder: Edge Homes is a Sumitomo Forestry subsidiary (70% bought in 2017), run by its original Utah management from Draper. It builds single-family homes, townhomes and condos only in Salt Lake and Utah counties (no St. George communities on its site), increasingly dense attached product on infill and redevelopment sites that it entitles itself. Since May 2026 it has a sister company in Utah, Tri Pointe Homes, also owned by Sumitomo Forestry.
